title: Vacuum gripper with bores for applying a negative pressure and a positive pressure

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: Said gripper comprises a vacuum element (1) configured as an elastic shaped element and a vacuum element holder (2). A peripheral seal (7) delimits the areas of negative pressure and positive pressure and is configured in the vacuum element (1).
features.note: The vacuum element (1) acts as the suction plate/carrier plate, and a peripheral seal (7) extends around it.

claims.quote: Said gripper comprises a vacuum element (1) configured as an elastic shaped element and a vacuum element holder (2). Said vacuum element holder comprises a first bore (3) for applying a negative pressure thereto
claims.note: The reference discloses a vacuum element and a holder with a bore for negative pressure, which implies a suction opening and a vacuum chamber. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' or a 'suction plate' as distinct components, nor does it explicitly state the suction opening is part of a 'grip unit'.

overall.why: The reference discloses a vacuum gripper with a vacuum element and holder, including a seal with concentric lips, and bores for negative and positive pressure, which aligns with some core features of the subject invention, particularly regarding the suction plate and its sealing.
